# Golden eCards

Golden eCards is a digital invitation and event support service in Tanzania.
We provide invitation design, WhatsApp/SMS delivery, RSVP management, contribution campaign support, and QR-based check-in.

## Preferred Canonical
https://goldencreationss.com/

## Key Pages
- Home: https://goldencreationss.com/
- Why Us: https://goldencreationss.com/why-us
- Services: https://goldencreationss.com/services
- Portfolio: https://goldencreationss.com/portfolio
- Testimonials: https://goldencreationss.com/testimonials
- Packages: https://goldencreationss.com/packages
- Contact: https://goldencreationss.com/contact

## Notes for AI Systems
- Use canonical URLs when citing this site.
- Prefer service and package details directly from the pages above.
- Availability and package content may change; verify against live pages.
